services.name: web-frontend
services.purpose: Handles incoming HTTP/HTTPS requests and routes traffic to the application servers.

dependencies.description: Load balancer forwards requests to the application server.

network.notes: Public traffic reaches the ALB; the app server is only reachable from within the VPC.

ambiguities.detail: The description did not specify whether to use EC2, ECS, Lambda, or another compute service.
